text.name: Quality Control
text.tagline: Record tests and control quality across supply and production
text.description: The Cyber ERP Quality Control module lets you define quality indicators, test methods, acceptance limits, and tests for materials, parts, products, and services. Sampling, result recording, and product grading are carried out in connection with inventory and production. Defining actions for out-of-range results, such as stopping production or returning a purchase receipt, together with indicator trend reports and contractor quality evaluation, helps you track the state of quality.
benefits: Define indicators and acceptance limits for tests
Record and track samples and test results
Assign product grades based on quality control results
Coordinate quality actions with inventory and production
Analyze quality trends and evaluate contractors

text.name: Quality Test Design
text.cardText: Design quality sheets and tests, and define actions for out-of-range results.
text.tagline: Define indicators, test methods, and acceptance limits
text.description: The Quality Test Design system defines quality indicators and their classifications, measurement methods, and acceptable limits. Linking tests to item types or applications and defining actions for out-of-range values provides a consistent basis for carrying out quality control.
benefits: Define acceptance limits for each indicator
Assign tests to the relevant application

text.name: Inspection
text.cardText: Define samples, run sampling approval workflows, and refer quality checks to specialist groups.
text.tagline: Track sampling and record inspection results
text.description: The Inspection system defines samples taken from production or inventory locations and links the required tests to them. Recording indicator results and referring part quality control requests to the relevant specialist group makes quality reviews easier to track. The recorded information serves as the basis for acceptance decisions and any required action.
benefits: Trace samples and their related tests

text.name: Raw Material and Product Quality Control
text.cardText: Record quality results, assign product grades, and coordinate quality decisions with inventory and production.
text.tagline: Control material acceptance and finished product quality
text.description: The Raw Material and Product Quality Control system compares test results for incoming and production samples against acceptance limits. Assigning product grades and taking actions such as stopping or continuing production, returning receipts, and notifying related units connects quality control to operations. Indicator trend reports make it possible to review changes in quality.
benefits: Control material quality in the supply process
Assign product grades based on test results
Coordinate quality actions with inventory and production
